meta.description: Compares hot and cold disaster recovery sites.

question.text: Which two statements about disaster recovery sites are generally accurate? Select two.
options: A hot site is typically equipped for relatively rapid service restoration
A cold site generally requires more setup before it can support operations
A cold site is always fully operational with live replicated systems
A hot site never requires testing or maintenance
correctAnswers: A hot site is typically equipped for relatively rapid service restoration
A cold site generally requires more setup before it can support operations
